title: Last 24: The day the sky fell
author: Bubbly-Trainer7173
selftext:
I'm developing a merge game about the 11 September attacks. Seems weird and creepy, but works well and has a very good story imo, with many playable subvariants, it's my main focus. I'm creating and writing the story and texts 100%, AI is creating the rest. It's in very early development.

Someone wants to try it from 11 September 2026 to ahead and give feedback?

I have the game in portuguese (my native language) and english (translated with AI).

Besides that, I want to know too if Gymnopedie nº1 is yet copyright music and if I need to remove it totally or not before sharing.  
I will improve the graphics when I finish the total structure, but I'm focusing in putting the playable ideas before.

https://preview.redd.it/3wq0t50fnvnh1.png?width=884&format=png&auto=webp&s=748066dcd2a74604de2a49d603b3791acff41948

I want to share it in Android and Windows.



https://preview.redd.it/4926240knvnh1.png?width=1207&format=png&auto=webp&s=2fc163432212705bb227865366c907adb25c63f9

I need to improve the translation, it has mix texts in some places. I will.

comments.body:
This was to be a book (is in advanced phase in that matter, with 1 prologue + 27 moments fro 22 wars+ 1 epilogue for 22 ways + 3 dreams for evey way already written), after was to be an interactive fiction. Finally I'm transforming it in a game.  
Are +-700 different text pages already written.
